hints.title: Bitmask Representation of Skills
hints.text: Since the number of required skills is at most 16, encode the skill set into a bitmask of length up to 16.

hints.title: Subproblem by Skill Mask
hints.text: Let state mask store the minimum list of person indices that cover that subset of skills.

hints.title: Dynamic State Expansion
hints.text: For each candidate person with personal skill mask, transition from existing reached states to union masks, updating when a smaller team is found.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exploring all subsets of people takes 2^M time, which is astronomically large for M=60.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inverting to bitmask over required skills reduces the state space to 2^N <= 65536.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that N <= 16 signals bitmask dynamic programming over skills rather than people.
complexity.notes: Initial state has mask 0 requiring 0 people.
